headline: Solaris holds Sandfire Resources as a high-conviction copper play, favouring management's capital discipline and the strategic Kalkaroo acquisition in a Tier 1 jurisdiction
reasoning: Sandfire provides direct exposure to copper, Solaris's favoured commodity, operating two producing mines at MATSA in Spain and Motheo in Botswana. quote: Sandfire Resources has been a strong recent contributor to the Fund, providing direct exposure to copper, our favoured commodity. The company operates two producing mines, MATSA in Spain and Motheo in Botswana, and while neither jurisdiction sits at the top of our preference list, management has demonstrated a consistent and disciplined approach to operating both assets. Central to our investment thesis is the quality of the management team, led by CEO Brendan Harris, who has instilled a rigorous capital allocation framework focused on extending mine life at existing operations rather than competing in what has become a crowded field for copper M&A. This approach, combined with the benefit of a strong copper price environment, has translated into meaningful free cash flow generation and a balance sheet that carries no debt and is in a net cash position. Sandfire recently acquired the Kalkaroo copper-gold project in South Australia, which we view as an astute strategic move. While the asset remains at an early stage and is some years from production, it is located in a Tier 1 jurisdiction with proximity to established regional infrastructure; rail, road, water and power and we see significant exploration upside and resource growth potential over the coming twelve months. In our view, the market is yet to fully appreciate the value embedded in Kalkaroo, and we expect this to become an increasingly important part of the Sandfire story as the asset progresses.
